Container.Name: PoliticianTracker
Container.Overview:
Politician Position Tracker - Track and analyze what politicians say on social media.
Link to posts on X (Twitter), Bluesky, Truth Social, or YouTube, then write analysis of why statements are problematic (e.g. First Amendment issues). Attach citations for both the original post and your analysis. Features include: timeline feed, politician profiles, issue tagging, social media embeds, admin panel with authentication, light/dark mode, data export, and share buttons.
You must set ADMIN_PASSWORD and SECRET_KEY. The container refuses to start on a default value, so there is no unprotected first boot.
Container.Description: Track politician statements from social media (X, Bluesky, Truth Social, YouTube) and analyze why they are problematic. Supports multiple issue tags, source citations, social embeds, screenshot backups, and full data export.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Path for database and uploaded files

Config.Name: Admin Password
Config.Description: Required. Password for the admin panel. The container will not start without one.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Required. Signs admin session tokens. Use a long random string, e.g. the output of: openssl rand -base64 32
